verdict.rationale: Better Auth's official SSO plugin explicitly supports OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0, which are the protocols used by Okta, Entra, and Google Workspace for workforce SSO (better-auth-docs-14). However, there is no documentation or community evidence naming specific IdP integrations (Okta/Entra/Google Workspace) or showing a hands-on enterprise SSO setup. missing for 10: named provider configuration guides (Okta/Entra/Google Workspace specifics), admin/dashboard SSO management, and independent/hands-on validation of the SSO plugin in production.
